about: Team stats. Each car is rated 0-10 in every stat; 5 is the stock car. Each point away from 5 changes the listed CarParams fields linearly: value *= 1 + per_point * (points - 5). A team spends at most the budget over all stats (8 stats x 5 = 40: raising one stat means lowering another). A full 0-10 swing in a lap-time stat is worth a few tenths a lap.

categories.label: Tyre management
categories.about: Kinder suspension and cooling: tyres wear more slowly and run cooler.

categories.label: Top speed
categories.about: Lower drag: faster on the straights.

categories.label: Acceleration
categories.about: More engine torque: quicker out of corners (and a little faster at the top).

categories.label: Downforce
categories.about: More aero grip in fast corners, at a small cost in drag.

categories.label: Handling
categories.about: Mechanical grip and a more agile chassis: slow corners and traction.

categories.label: Pit stop speed
categories.about: A quicker pit crew: shorter service time.

categories.label: Fuel efficiency
categories.about: Burns less fuel per lap: lighter cars or longer stints.

categories.label: Brakes
categories.about: More braking force: later braking from high speed, where downforce lets the tyres take it.
